arabic_text: أَللَّهُمَّ إنَّهُ يَحْجُبُنِي عَنْ مَسْأَلَتِكَ خِلاَلٌ ثَلاثٌ وَتَحْدُونِي عَلَيْهَا خَلَّةٌ وَاحِدَةٌ ، يَحْجُبُنِي أَمْرٌ أَمَرْتَ بِهِ فَأَبْطَأتُ عَنْهُ، وَنَهْيٌ نَهَيْتَنِي عَنْهُ فَأَسْرَعْتُ إلَيْهِ،
transliteration: allāhumma innahu yaḥjubunī ʿan mas'alatika khilālun thalāthatun wa taḥdūnī ʿalayhā khallatun wāḥidah yaḥjubunī amrun amarta bihī fa'abtaʾtu ʿanh wa-nahyun nahaytani 'anhu fa-asraʿtu ilayhi
english_text: O God, three traits have prevented me from asking Thee and one trait has urged me on: I am prevented by a command Thou hast commanded in which I have been slow, a prohibition Thou hast prohibited toward which I have hurried,

arabic_text: وَنِعْمَةٌ أَنْعَمْتَ بِهَا عَلَيَّ فَقَصَّرْتُ فِي شُكْرِهَـا.
transliteration: wa niʿmatun anʿamta bihā ʿalayya faqassarta fī shukrihā
english_text: and a favour through which Thou hast favoured for which I have not given sufficient thanks.

arabic_text: وَيَحْدُونِي عَلَى مَسْأَلَتِكَ تَفَضُّلُكَ عَلَى مَنْ أَقْبَلَ بِوَجْهِهِ إلَيْكَ، وَوَفَدَ بِحُسْنِ ظَنِّـهِ إلَيْكَ، إذْ جَمِيعُ إحْسَانِكَ تَفَضُّلٌ،
transliteration: wa yahdūnī ʿalā mas'alatika tafadhdhuluka ʿalā man aqbala biwajhihi ʾilayk wa wafada bi husni zannihi ilayka 'idh jamī'u iḥsānik tafadḍul'
english_text: I am urged to ask Thee by Thy gratuitous bounty upon him who turns his face toward Thee and comes to Thee with a good opinion, since all Thy beneficence is gratuitous bounty

arabic_text: وَإذْ كُلُّ نِعَمِكَ ابْتِدَاءٌ.
transliteration: wa-iḏ kullu niʿamika ibtidāʾ
english_text: and every one of Thy favours a new beginning!

arabic_text: فَهَا أَنَا ذَا يَا إلهِيْ وَاقِفٌ بِبَابِ عِزِّكَ وُقُوفَ المُسْتَسْلِمِ الذَّلِيْل، وَسَائِلُكَ عَلَى الْحَيَاءِ مِنّي سُؤَالَ الْبَائِسِ الْمُعِيْلِ. مُقـرٌّ لَكَ بأَنّي لَمْ أَسْتَسْلِمْ وَقْتَ إحْسَانِـكَ إلاَّ بِالاِقْلاَعِ عَنْ عِصْيَانِكَ،
transliteration: fahā anā dhā yā ilāhī wāqifun bibābi ʿizzika wuquuf al-mustaslimi al-dhaliil, wa-saa'iluka 'alaa al-hayaa' minni suʾāla al-bāʾisi al-muʿīl. muqirrun laka bi-annī lam astaslim waqt iḥsānik illā bil-iqlāʿi ʿan ʿiṣyānik
english_text: So here I am, my God, standing at the gate of Thy might, the standing of the lowly, the surrendered, asking Thee in my shame, the asking of the destitute, the pitiful, admitting to Thee that at the time of Thy beneficence I surrendered not save through abstaining from disobedience toward Thee

arabic_text: وَلَمْ أَخْلُ فِي الْحَالاتِ كُلِّهَا مِنِ امْتِنَانِكَ.
transliteration: walam akhlu fil-halat kulliha min imtinanika
english_text: and in none of my states was I ever without Thy Kindness.

arabic_text: فَهَلْ يَنْفَعُنِي يَا إلهِي إقْرَارِي عِنْدَكَ بِسُوءِ مَا اكْتَسَبْتُ؟
transliteration: fahal yanfa'unii yaa ilaahii iqraarii 'indak bi-suu'i maa aktasabt?
english_text: So will my confession before You, my God, of the evil I have earned, benefit me?

arabic_text: وَهَلْ يُنْجِيْنِي مِنْكَ اعْتِرَافِي لَكَ بِقَبِيْحِ مَا ارْتَكَبْتُ؟
transliteration: wa hal yunjīnī minka iʿtirāfī laka biqabīḥi mā irtakabtu?
english_text: Or will my confession to You of the vile things I have perpetrated save me from You?

arabic_text: أَمْ أَوْجَبْتَ لِي فِي مَقَامِي هَذَا سُخْطَكَ؟
transliteration: am ʾawjabta lī fī maqāmī hāḏā sukhtaka?
english_text: Or have You made Your wrath incumbent upon me in this station of mine?

arabic_text: أَمْ لَزِمَنِي فِي وَقْتِ دُعَائِي مَقْتُكَ؟
transliteration: am lazimani fi waqti du'ayi maqtuka?
english_text: Or has Your loathing become binding upon me at the time of my supplication?

arabic_text: سُبْحَانَكَ! لاَ أَيْأَسُ مِنْكَ وَقَدْ فَتَحْتَ لِيَ بَابَ التَّوْبَةِ إلَيْكَ،
transliteration: subḥānaka! lā ʾayʾasu minka waqad fataḥta li babat-tawba ʾilayka
english_text: Glory be to You! I do not despair of You, for You have opened for me the gate of repentance toward You;

arabic_text: بَلْ أَقُولُ مَقَالَ الْعَبْدِ الذَّلِيلِ الظَّالِمِ لِنَفْسِهِ الْمُسْتَخِفِّ بِحُرْمَةِ رَبِّهِ الَّذِي عَظُمَتْ ذُنُوبُهُ فَجَلَّتْ وَأَدْبَرَتْ أَيّامُهُ فَوَلَّتْ حَتَّى إذَا رَأى مُدَّةَ الْعَمَلِ قَدِ انْقَضَتْ
transliteration: bal aqoolu maaqalal 'abdi ath-thaleeli ath-thaalemi linafsihi al-mustakhiff bi hurmati rabbih allathee 'athumat thunoobuhu fajallat wa 'adbarat ayyamuhu fawallat ḥattā ʾiḏā raʾā muddata al-ʿamali qadi inqaḍat
english_text: rather, I speak the words of the lowly servant who wrongs himself, who takes lightly the sanctity of his Lord, whose sins have become immense and grave, and whose days have turned away and passed on, until, when he sees that the term for action has elapsed

arabic_text: وَغَايَةَ الْعُمُرِ قَدِ انْتَهَتْ ، وَأَيْقَنَ أَنَّهُ لا مَحيصَ لَهُ مِنْكَ ،وَلاَ مَهْرَبَ لَهُ عَنْكَ تَلَقَّاكَ بِالإنَابَةِ ،وَأَخْلَصَ لَكَ التَّوْبَةَ
transliteration: wa ghāyat al-ʿumuri qadi intahat wa-ʾayqana ʾannahū lā maḥīṣa lahū mink, walā maḥrab lahū ʿanka talqāka bil-ʾinābah, wa-ʾakhlasa lakat-tawbah
english_text: and the end of life has come, and becomes certain that there is no escape for him from You and no flight from You, he meets You by turning in repentance and devotes his repentance sincerely to You.

arabic_text: ، فَقَامَ إلَيْكَ بِقَلْبِ طَاهِر نَقِيٍّ ثُمَّ دَعَاكَ بِصَوْت حَائِل خَفِيٍّ ، قَدْ تَطَأطَأَ لَكَ فَانْحَنى، وَنَكَّسَ رَأسَهُ فَانْثَنَى ، قَدْ أَرْعَشَتْ خَشْيَتُهُ رِجْلَيْهِ، وَغَرَّقَتْ دُمُوعُهُ خَدَّيْهِ ،
transliteration: faqaama ilayka biqalbi ṭaahir naqiyyin thumma daʿāka biṣawt ḥāʾil khafīyin qad taṭaʾaṭa laka fa-anḥana, wa-nakkasa ra'sahu fa-anthanā qad arʿasht khashyatuhu rijlayhi, wagharrakat dumuuʿuhu khadayhi
english_text: Then he stands before You with a pure, clean heart and calls upon You in a broken, hushed voice, having lowered himself before You and bowed, and hung his head and bent over, his fear making his legs tremble and his tears drenching his cheeks,

arabic_text: يَدْعُوكَ بِيَا أَرْحَمَ الرَّاحِمِينَ وَيَا أَرْحَمَ مَنِ انْتَابَهُ الْمُسْتَرْحِمُونَ، وَيَا أَعْطَفَ مَنْ أَطَافَ بِهِ الْمُسْتَغْفِرُونَ ، وَيَا مَنْ عَفْوُهُ أكْثَرُ مِنْ نِقْمَتِهِ، وَيَا مَنْ رِضَاهُ أَوْفَرُ مِنْ سَخَطِهِ،
transliteration: yadʿūka biyā arḥama al-rāḥimīn wa yā arḥama mani intābahū al-mustarḥimūn wa yā ʿaṭafa man ʾaṭāfa bihi al-mustaghfiroon wayā man ʿafwuhu aktharu min niqmatihi wayā man riḍāhu ʾawfaru min sakhaṭihi
english_text: calling upon You: O Most Merciful of the merciful, O Most Merciful of those to whom seekers of mercy turn, O Most Tender of those to whom seekers of forgiveness draw near, O You whose pardon is more abundant than His retribution, O You whose good pleasure is more plentiful than His wrath,

arabic_text: وَيَا مَنْ تَحَمَّدَ إلَى خَلْقِهِ بِحُسْنِ التَّجاوُزِ ، وَيَا مَنْ عَوَّدَ عِبادَهُ قَبُولَ الإنَابَةِ ، وَيَا مَنِ اسْتَصْلَحَ فَاسِدَهُمْ بِالتَّوْبَةِ وَيَا مَنْ رَضِيَ مِنْ فِعْلِهِمْ بِالْيَسيرِ،
transliteration: wayā man taḥammada ilá khalqih bi-ḥusni at-tajāwuzi wa yā man ʿawwadah ʿibādahu qabūla al-inābati wayā mani istaṣlaḥa fasidahu bi-t-tawbah wayā man raḍiya min fiʿlihim bil-yasīr
english_text: O You who have made Yourself praiseworthy to Your creatures through excellent forbearance, O You who have accustomed Your servants to having their repentance accepted, O You who set right what is corrupt in them through repentance, O You who are satisfied with little of their deeds,

arabic_text: وَيَا مَنْ كَافى قَلِيْلَهُمْ بِالْكَثِيرِ، وَيَا مَنْ ضَمِنَ لَهُمْ إجَابَةَ الدُّعاءِ، وَيَا مَنْ وَعَدَهُمْ عَلَى نَفْسِهِ بِتَفَضُّلِهِ حُسْنَ الْجَزاءِ، مَا أَنَا بِأَعْصَى مَنْ عَصَاكَ فَغَفَرْتَ لَهُ،
transliteration: wa yā man kāfā qalīlahum bil-kathīr wa yā man ḍamina lahum ijābata al-duʿāʾi wa yā man waʿadahum ʿalā nafsihi bi-tafaḍḍulih husn al-jazāʾ mā ʾanā bi-ʾaʿṣā man ʿaṣāka faghafartalahu
english_text: O You who reward their little with much, O You who have guaranteed them an answer to supplication, O You who have pledged Yourself, out of Your bounty, to grant them excellent recompense, I am not more disobedient than one who disobeyed You and whom You forgave,

arabic_text: وَمَا أَنَا بِأَلْوَمِ مَنِ اعْتَذَرَ إلَيْكَ فَقَبِلْتَ مِنْهُ، وَمَا أَنَا بِأَظْلَمِ مَنْ تَابَ إلَيْكَ فَعُدْتَ عَلَيْهِ ،
transliteration: wa mā anā bi'alwam mani i'thara ilayka faqabilta minhu wa maa ana bi'athlamu man taaba ilayka fa'udta 'alayhi
english_text: nor more blameworthy than one who apologized to You and from whom You accepted it, nor more unjust than one who repented to You and to whom You returned.

arabic_text: أَتُوبُ إلَيْكَ فِي مَقَامِي هَذَا تَوْبَةَ نَادِم عَلَى مَا فَرَطَ مِنْهُ مُشْفِق مِمَّا اجْتَمَعَ عَلَيْهِ خَالِصِ الْحَيَاءِ مِمَّا وَقَعَ فِيْهِ ، عَالِم بِأَنَّ الْعَفْوَ عَنِ الذَّنْبِ الْعَظِيمِ لاَ يَتَعـاظَمُكَ، وَأَنَّ التَّجَـاوُزَ عَنِ الإثْمِ الْجَلِيْلِ لا يَسْتَصْعِبُكَ ،
transliteration: atūbu ʾilayka fī maqāmī hādhā tawbatan nādiman ʿalā mā faraṭa minh mušfiq mimma ʾiktama ʿalayhi ḫāliṣi l-ḥayāʾi mimma waqaʿa fīhi 'ālim bi-anna al-'afwa 'ani al-dhunb al-'aẓīm lā yataʿāẓamuka waanna at-tajawuza ʿani al-ithmi al-jalili la yastaṣʿibuka
english_text: I repent to You in this station of mine with the repentance of one remorseful for what has passed from him, fearful of what has amassed against him, utterly ashamed of what he has fallen into, knowing that forgiving the tremendous sin does not seem too great for You, that overlooking the grave offense does not prove difficult for You,

arabic_text: وَأَنَّ احْتِمَالَ الْجنَايَاتِ الْفَـاحِشَةِ لا يَتَكَأَّدُكَ، وَأَنَّ أَحَبَّ عِبَادِكَ إلَيْكَ مَنْ تَرَكَ الاسْتِكْبَارَ عَلَيْكَ، وَجَانَبَ الإِصْرَارَ، وَلَزِمَ الاسْتِغْفَارَ.
transliteration: wa anna ihtimāla al-jināyāti al-fāḥishati lā yataka'adduka wa anna aḥabba ʿibādika ilayka man taraka al-istikbāra ʿalayka wa janaba al-iṣrāra, wa lazima al-istighfāra
english_text: and that bearing outrageous crimes does not burden You, and knowing that the most beloved of Your servants to You is one who abandons arrogance before You, shuns persistence, and adheres to seeking forgiveness.

arabic_text: وَأَنَا أَبْرَأُ إلَيْكَ مِنْ أَنْ أَسْتَكْبِرَ، وَأَعُوذُ بِكَ مِنْ أَنْ أصِـرَّ.
transliteration: wa anā abrā'u ilayka min an astakbir wa-aʿūdhu bika min an aṣirra
english_text: I declare myself free before You from being arrogant, and I seek refuge in You from persisting.

arabic_text: وَأَسْتَغْفِرُكَ لِمَا قَصَّرْتُ فِيهِ ، وَأَسْتَعِينُ بِكَ عَلَى مَا عَجَزْتُ عَنْهُ.
transliteration: wa-astaghfiruka lima qassartu fihi wa-astaʿīnu bika ʿalā mā ʿajaztu ʿanh
english_text: I ask Your forgiveness for that wherein I have fallen short, and I seek Your help with that of which I have been incapable.

arabic_text: اللَّهُمَّ صَلِّ عَلَى مُحَمَّد وَآلِهِ وَهَبْ لِي مَا يَجبُ عَلَيَّ لَكَ ، وَعَافِنِي مِمَّا أَسْتَوْجِبُهُ مِنْكَ، وَأجِرْنِي مِمَّا يَخَافُهُ أَهْلُ الإساءَةِ
transliteration: allāhumma ṣalli ʿalā muḥammad wa ālih wa habli ma yajubu 'alayya laka wa ʿāfinī mimma astawjibuhu minka wa ajirni mimmā yakhāfu-hu ahlu al-isā'ah
english_text: O Allah, bless Muhammad and his Household, and grant me that which is incumbent upon me toward You, spare me from what I deserve from You, and protect me from that which the people of evil deeds fear.

arabic_text: فَإنَّكَ مَلِيءٌ بِالْعَفْوِ، مَرْجُوٌّ لِلْمَغْفِرَةِ، مَعْرُوفٌ بِالتَّجَاوُزِ ،
transliteration: fa'innaka malī'un bil-ʿafwi, marjūwun lil-maghfira, maʿrūfun bit-tajāwuzi
english_text: Surely You are full of pardon, hoped for in forgiveness, and known for overlooking.

arabic_text: لَيْسَ لِحَاجَتِي مَطْلَبٌ سِوَاكَ ، وَلا لِذَنْبِي غَافِرٌ غَيْرُكَ، َحاشَاكَ
transliteration: laysa li-ḥājati maṭlabun siwāka wa la li-thanbi ghafirun ghayruka, haashaaka
english_text: There is no one to whom I may turn with my need but You, and no forgiver of my sin other than You—far exalted are You!

arabic_text: وَلاَ أَخَافُ عَلَى نَفْسِي إلاّ إيَّاكَ
transliteration: wa lā akhāfu ʿalā nafsī illā iyyāka
english_text: And I fear for myself no one but You.

arabic_text: إنَّكَ أَهْلُ التَّقْوَى وَأَهْلُ الْمَغْفِرَةِ .
transliteration: 'innaka 'ahl al-taqwā wa 'ahl al-maghfirah
english_text: Surely You are worthy to be feared and worthy to forgive.

arabic_text: صَلِّ عَلَى مُحَمَّد وَآلِ مُحَمَّد، وَاقْض حَاجَتِي وَأَنْجِحْ طَلِبَتِي، وَاغْفِرْ ذَنْبِي، وَآمِنْ خَوْفَ نَفْسِيْ
transliteration: ṣalli ʿalā muḥammad wa āli muḥammad wa qḍ ḥāja ti wa anjih ṭalibatī waghfir dhambī, wa āmin khawfa nafsī
english_text: Bless Muhammad and the Household of Muhammad, fulfil my need, and bring my request to success, forgive my sin, and make my soul secure from its fear.

arabic_text: إنَّكَ عَلَى كُلِّ شَيْء قَدِيرٌ وَذلِكَ عَلَيْكَ يَسِيرٌ آمِينَ رَبَّ الْعَالَمِينَ .
transliteration: 'innaka 'alā kulli shay'in qadīr wa dhalika ʿalayka yaseerun ameen, rabb al-ʿalameen
english_text: Surely You are powerful over all things, and that is easy for You. Amen, Lord of the worlds.
